name: Motorcycle Simulator Georgia
summary:
Ride Atlanta from the seat - alone or with your friends.

53 KM OF REAL ATLANTA
The Downtown Connector past the Capitol's gold dome and Bank of America Plaza, I-75 north to Cumberland and Truist Park, I-285 across the top, GA 400 into Buckhead, then Piedmont Road, Ponce de Leon and Boulevard back downtown.

RIDE ONLINE TOGETHER
Up to four riders in a room. Quick Ride joins an open room or opens yours; Private Room gives your friends a 4-digit code. See each other lean, tuck and wave, with names and speeds o
